item: infobox addresses located through the local OSM index (S06-03 S2 + S3, R678, R691)
key_paths: src/wiki/located.py; src/wiki/coverage.py; src/api/wiki_lane.py; src/static/app-living.js; src/static/app-map.js; tests/test_wiki_located.py
summary: R17 step 4 for Wikipedia: the stored wikitext of HOT and WARM pages is read for organisation, institution, public-building and public-place infoboxes only (closed per-edition type list, failing closed, no generic building type, R691; a home named in any of 12 languages is skipped too; a page with a person infobox is never read), their address fields looked up only in the local OSM address index; located = 1-5 objects within 150 m, else counted ambiguous / not located / outside your OSM countries / no house number. Living sources shows n of m located, the map draws squares with provenance, the bundle member carries counts. Remains: addresses in article bodies (wiki and press) are a stated gap; row D closes on the operator's 72 h run and one OSM country ingested.
